en.headline: Police arrest private car driver after motorcycle collision in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A motorcyclist was trapped under a private car near King Lam Estate around noon on Sunday and later rescued conscious; the car driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving.
body: Police said a private car and a motorcycle collided around noon on Sunday at the Kai Jing Road roundabout near King Lam Estate in Tseung Kwan O.

The motorcyclist, a man in his 50s, was trapped under the front of the private car. Firefighters raised the vehicle and freed him. He remained conscious with injuries to his face, chest and limbs and was taken to hospital by ambulance.
After investigation, police arrested the private car driver, a man in his 60s, on suspicion of dangerous driving. The case is being handled by the East Kowloon Traffic Accident Investigation Team.

zh.headline: 將軍澳私家車與電單車相撞 鐵騎士一度困車底 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 周日中午佳景路近景林邨發生碰撞，電單車男司機被捲入車底獲救，清醒送院；私家車男司機涉嫌危險駕駛被捕。
body: 警方表示，周日中午約12時，一輛私家車與一輛電單車在將軍澳寶琳景林邨對開佳景路迴旋處相撞。
電單車男司機（50多歲）人仰車翻，一度被捲入私家車車頭底部受困。消防員到場將車身升高，小心將他救出。他臉部、胸部及四肢受傷，仍然清醒，由救護車送院治理。
警方調查後，相信電單車在讓路口停下時，後方私家車收刽不及撞上。私家車男司機（60多歲）涉嫌危險駕駛被捕，案件由東九龍交通意外調查隊跟進。
